text:
hannah: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem — we saw a recurring token-introspect regression plus a few services missing audit hooks. Starting a short ownership thread to track remediation, timelines, and a simple metric for recurrence.

tariq: TL;DR owners please?

hannah: Short list: 
  1) safe-rotator + dry-run automation 1 owner @tariq 1 target: dry-run tonight, staging deploy next day.
  2) admission-controller to require audit annotation in prod 1 owner @jules 1 target: PR by Tue.
  3) CI regression + smoke tests for introspect + rotator dry-run in CI 1 owner @aditi 1 target: Fri.
  4) runbook & oncall escalation steps 1 owner @leo 1 target: before staging deploy.

jules: Note — admission controller will include an allowlist for infra-managed legacy services. Will post PR link when ready.

tariq: Rotator plan: implement `--dry-run`, `--max-parallel`, `--introspect-timeout=5s`, and `--fail-open` for transient introspect errors. Dry-run will produce a candidates CSV. ETA: tonight.

aditi: CI plan: add a linter rule that fails on manifests missing `audit.redwood/enabled: "true"` and an integration harness that mocks introspect responses. Also add a weekly scheduled dry-run job in CI to detect regressions.

leo: I'll own the manual fallback doc: steps to revoke and reissue, how to notify downstream teams, and who to page. Will include a quick checklist and a rollback window. Link when ready.

hannah: Quick helper command to list tokens I used: 
```
kubectl get secrets -A -l redwood/service-token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.metadata.annotations.age}{"\n"}{end}'
```

ops-bot: deploy: admission-controller canary scheduled to dev at 2024-07-29T02:00Z.

sec-bot: security: ticket SEC-1402 created "Introspect flakiness mitigation + audit enforcement". Priority: P2.

tariq: PR opened for rotator (dry-run only): https://git.internal/redwood/ops/safe-rotator/pull/1. It emits telemetry events `rotation.success` and `rotation.failure` and tags `rotation.initiator`. Requesting reviews from @aditi and @jules.

jules: Draft PR for admission controller posted: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/456. Includes exception list `infra.redwood/legacy=true`. Will add docs.

aditi: CI PR posted: https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pull/88. Adds manifest lint and integration harness. Also adding a flakiness guard to ignore transient 5xx up to 3 occurrences in 10m.

leo: Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/token-rotate-emergency.md — includes manual verify steps, `--max-parallel` guidance, and an oncall pager matrix. Please review.

hannah: Proposed metrics to detect recurrence: `authz.audit_hook_coverage_pct` and `authz.introspect_error_rate_5m`. Closure criteria: >95% coverage for 14 days and introspect error rate < 0.5% for 14 days.

tariq: Added `--max-parallel=3` by default and `--dry-run=true` flag in PR. Rotator will skip rotate if `introspect.active_sessions > 0` and flag for manual review.

jules: One ask: admission controller should emit an event when it blocks a deploy so we can alert the owning team. Adding that to the PR.

aditi: I'll wire dashboards and weekly emails to ops. ETA for dashboard: 3 business days.

hannah: Scheduling a 20m sync Wed 09:00 PT to confirm PRs, runbook, and the staging dry-run results. If blocked, post short status here before 08:30 PT.

ops-bot: deploy: Rotator dry-run executed at 2024-06-22T23:40Z — candidates: 6, no revokes performed.

sec-bot: security: recommend a manual rotation drill in 1 week to validate procedures and oncall paging.

tariq: Acknowledged. Will coordinate drill with SRE.

hannah: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread as the canonical follow-up until the checklist is green. :thumbsup:
